doc.title: Lockout/Tagout
doc.purpose: Make sure no machine can start or release stored energy while someone is working inside it.

roles.name: Authorized Employee
roles.does: Applies their own lock and tag. Operators and Maintenance Technicians who are trained and listed.

roles.name: Line Lead
roles.does: Makes sure everyone affected knows the machine is locked out.

parameters.what: glue tank cool-down temperature before lockout work
parameters.quote: Case packers: also wait for the glue tank to cool below 60 degrees C or keep the tank lid closed and tagged.

rules.statement: One person, one lock, one key: each person applies their own lock to the hasp. The group lock box was removed in Rev D.
rules.quote: One person, one lock, one key. Each person working on the machine applies their own lock to the hasp.

rules.statement: Each person removes only their own lock; a lock left at shift change stays until its owner removes it or the Safety Manager authorises removal.
rules.quote: Each person removes only their own lock.

rules.statement: Authorized Employees (trained and listed Operators and Maintenance Technicians) apply their own lock and tag.
rules.quote: Operators and Maintenance Technicians who are trained and listed.

rules.statement: Lockout applies to all servicing, cleaning and jam clearing that puts any part of the body inside a guard, on any equipment at Plant 2.
rules.quote: All servicing, cleaning and jam clearing that puts any part of the body inside a guard, on any equipment at Plant 2.

unsure.why: The list is not part of this document and TR-701 has no row for the Authorized Employee role
